units.source_text: 第二天，我还是冒着暑热，上街去采买家人托我买的东西。

en.t: The next day, I still braved the summer heat and went into town to buy the things my family had asked me to get.

units.source_text: 看到信里列出的购物单时，还不觉得什么，一买起来才发觉真是够费事的。

en.t: When I saw the shopping list in the letter, it had not seemed like much, but once I actually started buying things I realized how troublesome it was.

units.source_text: 我在电车里一边擦汗，一边抱怨那些根本不懂得不该随便给别人添麻烦这个道理的乡下人。

en.t: In the streetcar, wiping away my sweat, I grumbled about those country people who had no idea that one should not casually put others to trouble.

units.source_text: 我不想白白度过这个夏天，

en.t: I did not want to let that summer pass in idleness,

units.source_text: 事先拟定好了回家后的读书计划，所以必须买些要看的书籍来履行这个计划。

en.t: so I had drawn up a reading plan in advance for after I returned home, and I had to buy the books I needed in order to carry it out.

units.source_text: 我打算在丸扇书店的二楼上消磨半天时间，

en.t: I intended to spend half the day on the second floor of Maruzen Bookstore,

units.source_text: 在与自己专业相关的书架前，我从一头走到另一头，一本一本地挑选着。

en.t: and in front of the shelves related to my field, I walked from one end to the other, choosing books one by one.

units.source_text: 要采购的清单中，最叫我头疼的是女人的半襟。

en.t: Of all the things on the shopping list, the one that troubled me most was a woman's haneri collar.

units.source_text: 跟店里的伙计一说想买半襟，他就拿出来好多件，可是买哪个好呢？

en.t: When I told the shop clerk I wanted to buy a haneri, he brought out any number of them, but which one was I supposed to choose?

units.source_text: 到了买的时候，我就举棋不定了，而且价钱也没个准头。

en.t: When it came time to buy one, I could only waver, and the prices seemed completely irregular too.

units.source_text: 本以为便宜的，一问却很贵，以为会很贵而没敢问的，结果却相当便宜。

en.t: Things I thought would be cheap turned out to be very expensive when I asked, while things I had assumed would be costly and had hesitated to ask about proved quite inexpensive.

units.source_text: 换句话说，无论怎么比较，我也弄不明白它们的价格差异是怎么出来的。

en.t: In other words, no matter how I compared them, I could not understand where the differences in price came from.

units.source_text: 我真是犯了难，暗自后悔，为何不劳动一下先生的夫人呢？

en.t: I was truly at a loss, and secretly regretted not having troubled Sensei's wife for help.
